subject.title: feat(gateway): archive-gated session deletes give Android delete parity

question: Should `operator.write` clients be allowed to delete already archived sessions through `sessions.delete` when they explicitly set `archivedOnly: true`?
rationale: This is an intentional destructive authorization-boundary change that was deferred from the session-management tracker, and automation should not decide that product/security policy even though the patch implementation looks sound.

options.title: Approve Archive-Gated Write Delete
options.body: Accept the two-step archive-then-delete contract and land this PR after exact-head CI/security checks finish.

options.title: Keep Delete Admin-Only
options.body: Reject the below-admin delete boundary and require Android legacy-token users to repair scopes or re-pair instead of deleting with write scope.

options.title: Require A Separate Delete RPC
options.body: Ask for a narrower write-scoped archived-session delete method if maintainers do not want dynamic behavior on `sessions.delete`.

recommendation.title: Approve Archive-Gated Write Delete
recommendation.body: Accept the two-step archive-then-delete contract and land this PR after exact-head CI/security checks finish.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the related session-management stack and documented this delete authorization question as the remaining follow-up.
